_comment: Text-decoder companion for LLaVA-1.5-7B. Mirrors ferrite-model-gemma3/configs/gemma-3-4b-it-mm.json — claims LlavaForConditionalGeneration with decoder_safetensors_prefix=language_model so weights load from language_model.<...>. Vicuna-7B-v1.5 is fine-tuned from Llama-2-7B and shares its architecture; vocab is extended from 32000 to 32064 by LLaVA to host image-token IDs (32000=<image>, 32001=<pad>).
